name: Form of the Drake I
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level alchemist 5, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 5, druid 6, magus 5, shaman 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a scale of the drake type you plan to assume)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Errata: In The Bardess’ Library #5, we said that a character could use the form of exotic dragon spell to assume the form of a land dragon. The new form of the nature dragon spell changes this.

Mythic Form of the Nature Dragon: The mythic form of the dragon spells found in Mythic Adventures can be also used as the mythic version of form of the nature dragon. They have the same effects, but each mythic spell must still be learned individually, and a spellcaster must know the respective non-mythic spell to learn its mythic version.

You become a Small or Medium drake. You gain darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, a breath weapon, and either resistance to one form of energy or some other bonus. In addition, if the form you assume has any of the following abilities, you gain the listed ability: 1 bite (1d4 if Small, 1d6 if Medium), burrow 20 ft., camouflage, 2 claws (1d3 if Small, 1d4 if Medium), climb 20 ft., constrict, fly 60 ft. (average), fogvision, grab, greensight 60 ft., hold breath, poison, pounce, scent, swim 60 ft., snow vision, speed surge, a sting 14 (1d3 if Small, 1d4 if Medium), 1 tail slap (1d4 if Small, 1d6 if Medium), woodland stride. Your breath weapon and resistance depend on the type of drake. You can only use the breath weapon once per casting of this spell. All breath weapons (except where indicated) have the form of balls that explode at a range of 40 feet and deal 4d8 points of damage in a 10-foot spread, allowing a Reflex save for half damage.

Small Drake: If the form you take is that of a Small drake, you gain a +4 size bonus to your Dexterity, and a +2 natural armor bonus.

Medium Drake: If the form you take is that of a Medium drake, you gain a +4 size bonus to your Strength, a +2 size bonus to your Constitution, and a +4 natural armor bonus.

Drake Type	Additional Abilities
Coral	15-foot cone of piercing, +4 bonus on saves vs. poison
Desert	Electricity, electricity resistance 20
Elemental	Acid, cold, electricity, or fire*, resistance 15 to the same type of energy
Ether	Ether bite (no breath weapon), spell resistance equal to 13 + the spell’s level
Fire	20-foot cone of fire, fire resistance 30, vulnerability to cold
Flame	Fire, fire resistance 30, vulnerability to cold
Forest	Acid, acid resistance 20
Frost	Cold, cold resistance 20, vulnerability to fire
Ice	20-foot cone of cold, cold resistance 20, vulnerability to fire
Jungle	Predatory grab (no breath weapon), +4 bonus on saves vs. poison
Lava	Fire, fire resistance 20, vulnerability to cold
Mist	Bludgeoning, misty camouflage
Rift	Acid, acid resistance 20
River	Acid, acid resistance 20
Salt	20-foot cone of slashing, fast healing 2
Sea	Electricity, electricity resistance 20
Shadow	Cold, cold resistance 20
Spire	Negative energy, +4 bonus on saves against negative energy effects, curses, and energy drain
Star	Cold or fire*, resistance 15 against the same type of energy

* Choose one when casting the spell.
